results.title: Left Right Christmas Game Printable, 10 Left Right Christmas Stories, Pass the Gift Game for Family, Office, Kids and Church Party
results.description:
Left Right Christmas game printable: 10 original read-aloud pass-the-gift stories for family, office, kids, classroom, church and seniors.

Everyone sits in a circle holding a wrapped gift. One person reads a story out loud. Every time you hear LEFT, pass your gift to the left. Every time you hear RIGHT, pass it to the right. When the story ends, the gift in your hands is yours. It's quick, silly and full of laughs, and this pack gives you 10 brand-new original stories so you have one for every party this season.

WHAT'S INCLUDED (12 PRINTABLE PAGES)
• Cover page
• How-to-play page: 4 ways to play, reader tips and a story picker showing who each story is best for, its LEFT and RIGHT counts and read time
• 10 one-page read-aloud stories, each with 15 to 18 LEFTs and 15 to 17 RIGHTs printed in bold color so the reader never misses one:
  1. Family: The Christmas Eve Cookie Caper
  2. Office: The Holiday Party in Suite 300
  3. Kids: The Snowman Who Lost His Hat
  4. Classroom: The Last Day Before Winter Break
  5. Friends: The Wrong-Turn Christmas Party
  6. Church & community: The Big Pageant Rehearsal
  7. Seniors: The Holiday Social at Maple Grove
  8. Couples: Our First Christmas Tree
  9. Big group: The Holly Lane Light Parade
  10. Rhyming: A Pass-the-Gift Christmas Rhyme

HOW TO PLAY
1. Everyone brings a wrapped gift (set a price limit) and sits in a circle.
2. Pick a reader and a story.
3. Pass left on every LEFT and right on every RIGHT.
4. Keep the gift you're holding when the story ends.
Other ways to play: pass one prize and the last person holding it wins, use a story to shuffle gifts before a white elephant swap, or split a big group into two circles and race. No gifts? Pass candy canes or a bag of treats.
For 6 to 40 players, all ages, 2 to 3 minutes per story.

FILES INCLUDED
• US Letter (8.5 x 11 in) and A4 PDFs

• This is an instant digital download. Nothing will be shipped.
